note: P3925 (Pro 11:24) — one gives freely yet grows richer; another withholds what is due and suffers want.

dims.v: generosity/its lack — withholding what is right brings want
the rightful giving that enriches when given, and brings want when withheld
(the freely-giving who grows richer, by contrast)
the due generosity set against the want that withholding brings

yosher (what is right/due) — 'another withholds what he should give and only suffers want'; the paradox of generosity — the liberal grow richer, the withholding grow poor. Rightful giving is self-enriching; hoarding self-impoverishing.
